rows.capability: session-resolution — one place decides which session a command acts on
rows.reads: .forge/sessions/*/session.json (phase, id, slug) and .forge/active.json as a hint, never as a fact
rows.writes: .forge/active.json via writeActive, from set-phase.mjs below every gate and never on done|skipped; writeJson is temp+rename
rows.runtimeOwner: packages/cli/src/set-phase.mjs resolves before any gate and refuses on ambiguity for done|finish; checkpoint.mjs, score-cli.mjs and review-label-cli.mjs refuse; defer, brief, e2e, metrics, spine, prefs and integrity-check warn and proceed; metrics/dispatches.mjs reads the pointer privately and stays on it deliberately (append-only telemetry, no gate) — recorded here so it is in an artifact rather than only in a grep
rows.uiConsumer: packages/cli/src/session-status.mjs reports sessionAmbiguity alongside its answer; session-reminder.mjs says so on the line the agent reads at session start
rows.evidence: e2e session-ambiguity: two sessions open, bare `forge phase done` refuses and writes neither a scorecard nor a ledger line, while `forge phase verify` warns and proceeds
